payload.core_mechanism_summary: Counts needed directional wind moves (E/W for x, N/S for y) by scanning the sequence once, decrementing remaining distances until both are zero; stops at the earliest time.
payload.rationale: The solution greedily takes any wind step moving toward the target, ignoring irrelevant ones; no backtracking or sorting needed. It directly computes the earliest time by linear accumulation of required steps.
